integrity: Exact symbolic proof, stand-alone direct multiplication/rank checker and an independently recorded small-field output are included; no independent expert certification.
scientific_limitations: Split basic associative algebras with semisimple quotient a product of copies of the base field; no general matrix-block quotient, noncommuting tuples, graph reconstruction, or recovery of deeper radical multiplication. The count proof is general, finite-field checks are corroborative. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Simultaneous idempotent spectra of split basic algebras and an inverse random-cluster invariant
